description: This file defines the WatchMessagingService class which manages communication between an iOS app and its paired Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity. It includes functions for checking support status, sending notifications, handling replies, and managing session states.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A service class for managing communication with Apple Watch via WatchConnectivity, supporting message sending, reply handling, and session management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the WatchMessagingService, setting up the WCSession if supported and activating it.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks whether the device supports WatchConnectivity sessions.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback to handle quick reply events received from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch with specified parameters, either immediately if reachable or queued otherwise.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated before performing message operations.
